title: Knowledge Check 2: Lessons 6–10
description: Pooled check over Lessons 6–10 of the Hermes Consultant series. Score 80% or higher to unlock the cert prep exam.

questions.question: Per the lesson “When an Agent Is the Right Tool, and When to Say No”, what is the central focus?
options: The honest consultant's rule: an agent is not always the right answer, and the consultant who can say no protects both the client's money and their own reputati…
A history of the technology and its vendors
A review of unrelated productivity tools
A summary of corporate policy rules
questions.explanation: The lesson is centered on: The honest consultant's rule: an agent is not always the right answer, and the consultant who can say no protects both the client's money and their own reputation. How to tell the work an agent should do from the work it should never touch, and how to walk away cleanly.
